changelog:
Initial release of crypto-gas-fee-optimizer:

- Fetches live gas prices from Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Polygon via free public RPC endpoints.
- Ranks chains by estimated USD transaction cost using live ETH/MATIC prices from CoinGecko.
- Offers one-call comparison and a general low-traffic timing note to help users pick cheaper chains or better transaction times.
- No API keys required; read-only and complementary to trading and DeFi tools.
- Useful for estimating costs before bridging, swapping, deploying contracts, or other on-chain actions.
summary: Check live gas prices across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Polygon in one call using free public RPC endpoints (no API key required), rank chains by estimated USD transaction cost, and get a general low-traffic timing note. Built for crypto traders, DeFi users, and smart contract deployers who want to pick the cheapest chain or time before sending a transaction. Complements trading, defi, and smart contract skills by covering the operational cost side of on-chain activity — useful before bridging, swapping, claiming an airdrop, deploying a contract, or moving whale-sized positions where gas costs compound across many transactions.
